verdict.rationale: Zero documents an official MCP server (ZeroMCP) that lets an external agent work the mailbox end to end. Reading is covered by getting threads, listing folders and searching. Triage is covered by labels, mark read/unread, bulk archive and delete. Drafting and sending are covered by create drafts, send drafts and compose-and-send. The documented connection is weak, though: it requires copying a browser session cookie into the Authorization header, and OAuth is only 'coming soon'. That makes connecting Claude, ChatGPT or a custom agent more fragile than a proper connector. Missing for 10: production-grade auth (OAuth) for the agent connection, in-depth tool/schema documentation beyond feature bullet lists, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents completing the end-to-end flow.
